order: Read the producer association. Enumerate all candidates; names and sampled hashes rank suggestions. Automatic relocation requires a historical full-digest match, otherwise confirmation.
For an existing canonical original, read all bytes on reopen/proxy activation. Missing full provenance invalidates legacy proxy eligibility.
Generate from a private stable input snapshot into a unique temporary proxy. Reject failed or obsolete job completion.
Publish verified proxy without replacing unrelated associations; then update only the target producer's original, digests, proxy reference, and applicable hash/caption.
Save original and provenance together through temporary project output and atomic replacement where supported. Before publication, persist prior or unresolved state.
